prompt:
Production Unity enemy Spitter animation sheet. Input reference is exact silhouette, proportions and view, not a frame to duplicate. Redraw the same creature with articulated animated poses. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray tendon limbs, subtle amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D, elevated 45deg camera fixed, soft upper-left light. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
Direction MUST remain REAR view facing straight away toward TOP center, rear legs nearest viewer, back armor dominates, no front-facing eye slit; every pose is strictly back view, never turn. throughout all frames. Front limbs/head point toward top, hind limbs nearest bottom in rear views. When doing a slam, keep HIND feet nearest viewer braced on ground; raise the FRONT feet far from viewer.
FOUR COLUMNS, 6 ROWS, exactly 24 full creatures, PORTRAIT image width:height=4:6. Generous 20% transparent space around each sprite within its cell. Never overlap/touch any adjacent frame. Same body scale and foot anchor each frame. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Four consistent limbs, one head, same armor layout. No duplicate stills, no rotation-only simulation. Fully transparent background alpha0 and clean transparent gaps between legs. No floor or cast shadows, no text/labels/grid, no particles, no projectile.
